recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future publisher regression renders the extension value list as a bare lowercase `markdown` item again.
issue_request: FHIR-8711 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction asking that the Extension.value[x] type list show Markdown rather than a bare lowercase markdown entry inconsistent with neighboring display names.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit df193182d00959edc0df05745da24da89edf132c, svn r7047, which changed the old list from a bare markdown item to `valueMarkdown : markdown`. Commit dcd3ffda9020726ce3628f04603b19e4bf289c52 later replaced the manual list with the shared `[%extension-type-list%]` generator placeholder.
additional_context: Extension is still active build-scope infrastructure. The current extensibility page source states that value[x] is named `value` plus the TitleCased type name and delegates the list to a generated placeholder; the primitive datatype source still correctly defines the canonical type code as lowercase `markdown`. build.fhir.org renders `valueMarkdown: markdown` and the Extension profile type code remains `markdown`. No relevant conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is appropriate because changing the datatype code/link label to `Markdown` would now be incorrect, while the representation-level casing requested by the issue is already satisfied.
